# Extended MKCOL (RFC 5689) makes a calendar like MKCALENDAR; a plain
# collection is refused (valid-resourcetype), CardDAV keeps one book.
> MKCOL /caldav/alex/calendars/reisen/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:mkcol xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><A:set><A:prop>
>   <A:resourcetype><A:collection/><B:calendar/></A:resourcetype>
>   <A:displayname>Reisen</A:displayname>
>   <D:calendar-color xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/">#34C759</D:calendar-color>
>   <B:supported-calendar-component-set><B:comp name="VEVENT"/></B:supported-calendar-component-set>
> </A:prop></A:set></A:mkcol>
< status 201

# The first own calendar makes the virtual default real as well (pim/store,
# TestVirtualKeptByOwnCalendar): a device that synced "privat" keeps it.
> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
< status 207
< responses 4
# (and the virtual reminder list, 1.13: reminders.txt)
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ d:displayname Privat
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/reisen/ d:displayname Reisen
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/reisen/ ical:calendar-color #34C759
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/reisen/ d:resourcetype <cal:calendar/>

> MKCOL /caldav/alex/calendars/reisen/
> Auth: alex
< status 405

> MKCOL /caldav/alex/calendars/ordner/
> Auth: alex
>

< status 403
< error d:valid-resourcetype
